import.css:
.ts-x-nearest-page-routing svg.dia .ic { width: 24px; height: 24px; }
.ts-x-nearest-page-routing svg.dia .ic.muted { width: 20px; height: 20px; }

head.text: A mistyped docs URL resolves to the nearest page. The resolver, merged on September 8, tries four rungs in order and then shows suggestions. A difference in version numbers is never treated as a typo.

blocks.alt: Four matching rungs tried in order: exact path, segments, basename, parent folder. One match at any rung redirects to the page; no match at any rung shows up to five suggested pages
